_meta.rationale: Apple's San Francisco / SF Pro first-preference face maps to Inter in BRAND_FONT_REGISTRY (both 'san francisco' and 'sf pro' keys carry the same mapping). Primary alphabet display element is h1.a-display-1; the :root override forces --ds-font-display to Inter. Negative assertion mirrors slug=apple strip targets (apple-logo, /ac-globalnav/svg/logo, apple.svg).
gaps: Apple is not in fidelity_targets.yml; this spec is authored ahead of reference-capture rollout so the gate reports MISSING_REFERENCE for any apple tuple until captures land. The spec is still validatable as a fidelity_spec_v2 artifact.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('h1.a-display-1'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['apple.com/logo', 'apple-logo', '/ac-globalnav/svg/logo', 'apple.svg', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-body'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
